page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number 17 at top right. Main text in two columns of paragraphs with woodcut figures of fish set into the text block on the right (figure labels "Pauo" and "Psittacus" in the right margin as notes). Below the text, German and Gallic lines set as full-width paragraphs. Signature "B 3" at the foot right.

main_text.l: ipsum tamen, ni fallor, Turdis cognatum exhibuisse uidetur: cuius uerba recitabimus infra.
GERM. F. Sie ander art der
Krametfischen oder Meerpfawen/ von farben an flossfadern vnd am schwantz blawgrün/ wie ein Pfaw am halß.
gna ex parte: sed pūctis pur-
GALLICE (circa Monspelium puto) Minchia di Re à nonnullis uocatur, ut Rondeletius scri-
bit. at Saluianus Iulidem Romae & Neapoli obscoena uoce
Menchia di Re (id est, Mentulam regis) uocari tradit.
GERM. F. Sie dritte art der Kramerfischen / ist am meerern
teil seins leybs grün/ mit mancherley tüpflinen/ roten/ blawen vnd andern gesprecklet.
oculorum uarietatem: de quo in feriùs post Rondeletij Turdos leges.
GALLICE Perroquet, ut iam dictum est.
GERM. F. Sie vierdte art der Krametfischen/
am rucke schwartzlacht/ mit einer grün lachten flossfädern darauff. wirdt bey Montpelier
von ettlichen ein Pappegey genennt / von wägen seiner farben.
TVRDO Rondeletij quarto cognatus uidetur piscis, cuius
imaginem, qualem Venetijs (ubi Porga, si bene scribo, uulgò uocatur) nactus sum, hic exhibeo.
Colores in pictura nostra, huiusmodi fere sunt: Dorsum & latērum dimidia pars superior, fusci sunt
coloris, maculis crebris subnigris uariantibus. Lineae tres aut quatuor caeruleae à branchijs ad
caudam tendunt. In oculis circuli duo aurei pupillam ambiunt, inter quos medius unus fusci coloris
est. Cauda quoque maiori ex parte caerulea est; idemq; color initio pinnarum ad branchias, & in capite circa infraq; branchias

page.notes: Two woodcut fish figures sit within the text block: Pauo (top) and Psittacus (middle). Text is set in a Latin/German/French mix; the German lines are printed in smaller type and are treated as foot notes. The bottom line of the page is cut off at the foot and the final word is incomplete. The running head is partly damaged. The signature "B 3" is read as "B 3" with some uncertainty.
